description: This file contains the implementation of the DownloadItem data class, the DownloadStatus enum, and the DownloadController class, which manages download states, persistence, and interactions with the download engine within a Flutter application.

classes.name: DownloadItem
classes.description: A data class representing a download item with properties such as id, contentId, title, status, progress, and timestamps, including methods to convert from and to database row formats.

classes.name: DownloadController
classes.description: A controller class managing download operations, including restoring download states, enqueuing, removing, pausing, resuming downloads, and managing global download queue status, with state persistence and interaction with the download engine.

methods.name: restoreFromDisk
methods.description: Restores the download queue and items from the database; activates in-progress downloads if not paused.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download item to the persistent queue and starts its download if not globally paused.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a download item from the database and cancels its ongoing download.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the global download queue pause state and updates ongoing downloads accordingly.

methods.name: pauseItem
methods.description: Pauses a single download item without affecting the global queue.

methods.name: resumeItem
methods.description: Resumes a paused download item if the global queue is active.

methods.name: _setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and timestamp of a specific download item in the database.

methods.name: _upsertProgress
methods.description: Updates progress, bytes downloaded, total bytes, and status of a download in the database.

methods.name: _startSimulation
methods.description: Initiates a simulated download process via the download engine, updating progress callbacks.
